_comment: Per-agent model and thinking level, per harness. This file is the single source:
`scripts/sync-agent-models.py` writes these values into every agent's frontmatter,
and `--check` fails when a file has drifted. bootstrap-plugins.sh syncs before it
installs, so editing here and re-running the installer is the whole workflow.
Fields per harness, and where each one actually takes effect — verified against
each CLI, not assumed. The three harnesses differ in what they can scope per agent:
claude -> model: opus | sonnet | haiku | inherit   effort: low|medium|high|xhigh
Both are real agent frontmatter. Fully per-agent.
codex  -> model: <model id>                        effort: low|medium|high|xhigh
Codex reads NO per-agent model surface: a plugin manifest accepts no
`agents` key, and a skill's agents/openai.yaml is UI metadata only. So
these are written twice — into agents/codex/*.md, which documents intent
and will matter once Codex agents ship as skills, and into a real
profile at $CODEX_HOME/swarm-<agent>.config.toml, which `codex
--profile swarm-<agent>` layers over the base config. The profile is
the half that works today.
agy    -> model: pro | flash | inherit             (no per-agent effort)
`model` is real agent frontmatter, defaulting to `inherit` (the
parent's model). Antigravity does have reasoning effort, but only
session-wide, via the `/effort` command or the `--effort` launch flag —
there is no frontmatter key for it, so an effort set here would be a lie.
An agent inherits `defaults` for any field it does not override.

planner._why: Investigation and decomposition set the ceiling for the whole milestone; a weak plan costs every wave after it.

test-author._why: Writes the Definition of Done nobody downstream can weaken. A lazy oracle here is invisible and permanent.

builder._why: Implements against a fixed target, with the guard and two review passes behind it.

code-reviewer._why: One lens over one diff, structured output. Narrow and repeated, so it runs cheap and often.

integrator._why: Runs commands and reports evidence. The judgment is bisecting a combined failure, not writing code.

research._why: Gathers evidence for one area; the orchestrator synthesizes. Breadth matters more than depth per agent.

docs._why: Prose against a fixed standard, over code someone else already settled.

deploy._why: Outward-facing and hard to reverse; a wrong call costs more than the tokens saved.

debugger._why: Hypothesis forming and refutation is the hardest reasoning in the fleet; a wrong root cause sends a builder to fix the wrong thing.

benchmarker._why: Disciplined measurement, not deep reasoning. The rigour is in the method, which this file cannot buy with a bigger model.
